spec: analysis/prereg_r2_draft.md: R2 wording robustness (registered 2026-10-31, before any R2 data). Claude-only default run. Part A: restart-hint wording, 16 graphs x r=2 per (model, context). Part B: error wording after commit, 32 tasks x r=2 per (model, condition), base prompt, no mitigation. Part C: same-month plan_only on the 8 four-node chain graphs x r=2 (= the July chain plan_only design). The OpenRouter models are an optional extension in configs/r2_wording_or.json, not run by default.
